scripts.setup: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/setup-dictation.mjs && pnpm build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && uv run --frozen --project dictation/worker ty check dictation/worker
scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings=0 . && uv run --frozen --project dictation/worker ruff format --check dictation/worker && uv run --frozen --project dictation/worker ruff check dictation/worker
scripts.fix: eslint --fix . && uv run --frozen --project dictation/worker ruff format dictation/worker && uv run --frozen --project dictation/worker ruff check --fix dictation/worker && pnpm check
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm knip && pnpm secrets && pnpm test
scripts.audit: pnpm audit && uv audit --frozen --preview-features audit-command --project dictation/worker
